risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Training Environments, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), Failure to Achieve Strategic / Mission Objectives (R-EX-8), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to provide all employees and contractors appropriate security, compliance and resilience awareness education and training that is relevant for their job function.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Automated Training Environments (BCD-09.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Contingency Training
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to adequately train contingency personnel and applicable stakeholders in their contingency roles and responsibilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Contingency Training (BCD-09) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Automated Training Environments (BCD-09.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats.
